questions.question: Azure resurs ierarxiyasi: Management Group, Subscription, Resource Group, Resource. AWS'dagi qaysi tushunchalarga mos?
questions.explanation: Management Group — subscription'larni guruhlaydi (AWS Organizations OU); Subscription — billing va limit chegarasi (AWS account); Resource Group — bir hayot siklidagi resurslar konteyneri (AWS'da aniq mosi yo'q, tag'larga yaqin); Resource — VM, DB va h.k.

questions.question: Azure'da VNet, Subnet, NSG va Azure Firewall farqi?
questions.explanation: VNet — izolyatsiyalangan tarmoq (AWS VPC), Subnet — uning qismi. NSG — subnet yoki NIC'ga qo'yiladigan stateful L3/L4 qoidalar (SG + NACL o'rtasidagi narsa). Azure Firewall — markaziy boshqariladigan, FQDN/L7 filtrlaydigan firewall servisi (hub VNet'da).

questions.question: Azure DevOps Pipelines va GitHub Actions: Azure'ga deploy qilishning zamonaviy usuli?
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi YAML pipeline. Zamonaviy Azure auth — workload identity federation (OIDC): service connection yoki `azure/login` secret'siz, federated credential bilan. Client secret saqlash eski usul.

questions.question: Managed Identity nima? System-assigned va user-assigned farqi?
questions.explanation: Managed Identity — Azure resursi (VM, App Service, AKS pod) uchun Entra ID identiteti: kod secret saqlamasdan token oladi (AWS IAM role'ga mos). System-assigned resurs bilan yaratiladi va o'chadi; user-assigned — alohida resurs, bir nechta resursga biriktiriladi.

questions.question: Azure RBAC va Azure Policy farqi?
questions.explanation: RBAC — KIM nima qila oladi (role assignment: principal + role + scope). Policy — NIMA yaratilishi mumkin (qoidalar: faqat ma'lum region, tag majburiy, public IP taqiqlangan) — ruxsati bor odam uchun ham. Ikkalasi management group'dan pastga meros qoladi.

questions.question: AKS'ni production uchun qanday sozlaysiz (asosiy qarorlar)?
questions.explanation: Qarorlar: tarmoq (Azure CNI Overlay yoki CNI Cilium), system va user node pool'larni ajratish, availability zone'lar, Workload Identity, private cluster yoki authorized IP, cluster autoscaler, upgrade kanali, Azure Monitor/Managed Prometheus, Key Vault CSI.
